title: Iced Matcha Glow
description: A bright, refreshing matcha that feels polished yet easy.
instructions: Whisk matcha with warm water until silky.
Shake with oat milk and honey.
Pour over ice and finish with a citrus twist.
designNotes: Use a pale green palette with cream undertones.
Pair with soft bronze details and a clean glass silhouette.

title: Cozy Cinnamon Latte
description: A velvety espresso drink with a sweet spice glow.
instructions: Brew espresso and stir in brown sugar.
Pour over espresso and dust with cinnamon.
designNotes: Frame it in warm espresso and ochre accents.
Use rounded ceramic props and a wood-toned backdrop.

title: Berry Garden Spritz
description: A fruity, herbaceous refresher with a garden glow.
instructions: Combine syrup and mint in a glass.
designNotes: Lean into berry reds and green herbs for a fresh palette.
Use a bright, airy layout with soft shadows.
